svg.title: GigaAM-v4 and GigaAM Multilingual-v2
svg.desc: Architecture, multilingual word accuracy and Russian and English word error rates for five speech recognition models.
svg.text: Best of 6 open-weight models per language
Multilingual evaluation: dataset macro, auto language. Common Voice, FLEURS + internal data. Word Accuracy = max(0, 100 - Word Error Rate).
Open-weight models: Whisper large-v3, Qwen3-ASR 1.7B, Omnilingual LLM 7B, Nemotron 30B-A4B, Rumble-2-Flash, Parakeet Ultra.
